card.title: The Maker — a persistent value profile, and what a bounded-family reader recovers

criteria.C1_convergence: s15 bounded_clean: accuracy(n=1) <= 0.60 AND accuracy(n=50) >= 0.95 AND spearman(accuracy, n) >= 0.90
criteria.C2_assumption_price: s15 L1 at n=50: bounded_clean beats unbounded_family by >= 0.05 AND beats wrong_expertise by >= 0.05
criteria.C3_construction_gap: s15 accuracy at n=1: construction_B minus bounded_clean >= 0.25
criteria.C4_corpus_price: s15 bounded_noisy: report smallest n with accuracy >= 0.90. No bar
criteria.C5_aperture: s14: commissioned masked-vs-unused accuracy at n=12 >= 0.85 AND commissioned minus spontaneous accuracy >= 0.20
criteria.C6_how_channel: s14: with lambda=1 (pure compliance) commissioned accuracy <= 0.60
criteria.C7_smear: s12: three-locus mean profile reads unimodal in >= 80% of repetitions
criteria.C8_separation: s12: early-late residual statistic separates the worlds at AUC >= 0.80

authors_recorded_priors.C3: The sibling's real-text record — single-artifact values attempts all failed, within-maker multi-work designs all worked, no acceleration at stacked motivations — sides with construction A. If B wins the discrimination the record's reading of those results must be revisited.
authors_recorded_priors.C7: If the three-locus world does NOT smear, the field's mid-peak consensus cannot be explained this way and the trimodal architecture answers to the data as published.
